# UNREVIEWED MACHINE TRANSCRIPTION — a made-up draft for capture-prefilter's tests.
# source: https://example.com/made-up-stew
TITLE: Made-up stew
SERVINGS (as given): 4

INGREDIENTS
- 1 tablespoon butter
- 2 tablespoons butter
- 2 cups beef stock
- ½ cup beef broth
- 1 cup flour
- parsley, chopped
- 1 cup frobnicated zizzle

STEPS
1. Preheat the oven to 450°.
2. Melt 1 tablespoon butter, then 2 tablespoons butter, then 1 tablespoon butter.
3. Add 1 cup flour and cook for 10 minutes.
4. Bake at 325°F for 2 hours.
